title: avd-target-approval/v1: a person's approval of one exact avd-target-state/v1 file
description: Contract C14. Sits next to the manifest it approves. manifestSha256 is over the manifest file's exact bytes, so any edit after approval needs a new approval. Who approved is the commit or PR in the customer's private repo that added this file, never a name in it.
